articles.summary: Jev raised our product categorization accuracy from 81.9% to 97.2% at about the same cost, when we used it to choose from 30 prefiltered categories. Searching the full taxonomy with it was too expensive.
articles.title: Where Jev Fits in a Large-Scale Data Pipeline

articles.summary: Every store writes sizes and colors its own way. Here is how Channel3 matches them into one product, so an agent that asks for a brown men's 10 gets every listing that sells exactly that.
articles.title: Before an AI agent can buy the right size
